scope: Coastal Bend (Nueces, San Patricio, Victoria, Kleberg counties; Corpus Christi, Victoria)

records.name: Coastal Bend Food Bank
records.description_en: The regional food bank for Corpus Christi and nearby rural counties. It sends food to partner pantries and churches, and runs a Senior Food Box program, a diabetes food pantry, nutrition classes, and help applying for benefits like SNAP.
records.description_es: Es el banco de comida de Corpus Christi y de los condados rurales cercanos. Reparte comida a despensas y a iglesias. También tiene cajas de comida para personas mayores, una despensa para personas con diabetes, clases de nutrición y ayuda para pedir beneficios como SNAP (estampillas de comida).
records.eligibility_summary_en: The food bank does not give food directly to people. Each partner pantry has its own rules, so ask the pantry near you.
records.eligibility_summary_es: El banco de comida no da comida directamente a las personas. Cada despensa tiene sus propias reglas, así que pregunte en la despensa más cercana.
records.how_to_apply: Call the food bank with your zip code and staff will refer you to the partner pantry closest to your home.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al banco de comida y diga su código postal. El personal le dirá cuál es la despensa más cerca de su casa.
records.notes: The site says it serves Corpus Christi and 11 rural counties but does not list them on this page. Programs (Senior Food Box, diabetes pantry, SNAP help) are listed at coastalbendfoodbank.org/get-help. Email: Coastalbendfb@coastalbendfoodbank.org.

records.name: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.organization: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.description_en: A regional food bank in Victoria that supplies partner pantries and runs mobile food pantries and a senior food box program across 11 counties.
records.description_es: Es un banco de comida en Victoria. Abastece a despensas de la zona y tiene despensas móviles y cajas de comida para personas mayores en 11 condados.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Golden Crescent area, including Victoria County, who need food. Eligibility rules are not listed online, so call to ask.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del área Golden Crescent, incluido el condado de Victoria, que necesitan comida. Las reglas no están en internet, así que llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Food Pantry Map at tfbgc.org/food-assistance to find a pantry near you, or call the food bank.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el mapa de despensas en tfbgc.org/food-assistance para encontrar una despensa cerca de usted, o llame al banco de comida.
records.notes: Serves Calhoun, Colorado, DeWitt, Goliad, Gonzales, Jackson, Lavaca, Matagorda, Refugio, Victoria, and Wharton counties. Check its Facebook page for weather cancellations of mobile distributions.

records.name: Senior Box Program (CSFP)
records.organization: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.description_en: A free monthly box of food for older adults. Boxes are given out at sites in each county, often with drive-thru pickup.
records.description_es: Una caja de comida gratis cada mes para personas mayores. Las cajas se entregan en lugares de cada condado, muchas veces sin bajarse del carro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents age 60 and older in the food bank's service area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más que viven en el área del banco de comida.
records.how_to_apply: Call 361-578-0591 to register. New applicants may also register after 10:30 am on distribution day at the pickup site.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 361-578-0591 para inscribirse. Si es nuevo, también puede inscribirse después de las 10:30 am el día de entrega en el lugar de recogida.
records.notes: CSFP usually has an income limit, but the page does not state it. Pickup sites and dates vary by county; see tfbgc.org/food-assistance.

records.name: Mobile Pantry Distribution (TEFAP)
records.organization: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.description_en: Monthly drive-thru food giveaways at community sites across the Golden Crescent area.
records.description_es: Entregas de comida gratis cada mes, desde su carro, en lugares de la comunidad en toda el área Golden Crescent.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households in the food bank's service area who need food. You must register by phone.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del área del banco de comida que necesitan comida. Tiene que inscribirse por teléfono.
records.how_to_apply: Call 361-578-0591 to register and get the date and place of the next distribution.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 361-578-0591 para inscribirse y saber la fecha y el lugar de la próxima entrega.
records.notes: Mobile distributions can be delayed or rescheduled because of weather; check the food bank's Facebook page.

records.name: Utility Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Helps pay electric, gas, and propane bills for low-income households. It can also pay for emergency repair of heating or cooling systems.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas y propano de familias de bajos ingresos. También puede pagar reparaciones urgentes de la calefacción o el aire acondicionado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For San Patricio County households (and some other South Texas counties) with income at or below 150% of the federal poverty level. Seniors, people with disabilities, and families with children under 5 get priority.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del condado de San Patricio (y de otros condados del sur de Texas) con ingresos de hasta 150% del nivel federal de pobreza. Las personas mayores, las personas con discapacidad y las familias con niños menores de 5 años tienen prioridad.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: San Patricio County resident (in this region)

documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for each household member
Pay stubs for the last 30 days or 2025 benefit award letters
SNAP/TANF benefits letter dated within 30 days, if you get those benefits
records.how_to_apply: Request an appointment with the online form, or call the Sinton office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida una cita con el formulario en internet o llame a la oficina de Sinton.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 9:00 am-12:00 pm and 1:00 pm-4:00 pm
records.notes: CACOST's CEAP area is Cameron, Willacy, Brooks, Duval, Jim Wells, Bee, and San Patricio counties (plus Brownsville). It does NOT cover Nueces, Kleberg, or Victoria; for those, call 2-1-1. 2026 limit example: household of 4 at or below $49,500 per year. Sending a request does not guarantee an appointment; appointments depend on available funding.

records.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Makes homes more energy efficient with free repairs, which can lower utility bills.
records.description_es: Hace reparaciones gratis en su casa para que use menos energía. Esto puede bajar sus cuentas de luz y gas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Kleberg, San Patricio, and nearby counties. The limit is 150% of the poverty level for LIHEAP weatherization or 200% for DOE weatherization.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de Kleberg, San Patricio y otros cercanos. El límite es 150% del nivel de pobreza para el programa LIHEAP o 200% para el programa DOE.
documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for all household members
Recent pay stubs or 2025 benefit award letters
Current electric and gas bills (front and back)
records.how_to_apply: Call the Alice office for Kleberg and San Patricio counties. Applications are available in English and Spanish on the CACOST website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Alice si vive en los condados de Kleberg o San Patricio. Las solicitudes están en inglés y en español en el sitio web de CACOST.
records.notes: Two tiers: LIHEAP WAP up to 150% FPL; DOE WAP up to 200% FPL. Example: 1-person household up to $23,940 (LIHEAP) or $31,920 (DOE) in 2026.

records.name: Senior Nutrition Services (Congregate Meals and Meals on Wheels)
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Hot meals for seniors at senior centers with activities, or meals delivered to the homes of seniors who cannot leave home. Rides to the centers are available.
records.description_es: Comidas calientes para personas mayores en centros para adultos mayores con actividades, o comidas llevadas a la casa de quienes no pueden salir. Hay transporte a los centros.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people age 60 and older and their spouses in San Patricio County (and Bee, Brooks, and Jim Wells). A home visit checks eligibility.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de 60 años o más y sus esposos o esposas en el condado de San Patricio (y en Bee, Brooks y Jim Wells). Una visita a la casa revisa si usted califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call 361-664-0099 or contact a local senior meal site.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 361-664-0099 o comuníquese con un centro de comidas para mayores cerca de usted.
records.cost: Suggested voluntary donation of $1.00 per day
records.notes: Address is CACOST's main office in Alice. Some people with disabilities may also qualify regardless of age. An in-home assessment is required.

records.name: Head Start Birth to Five
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Free early learning and child care for babies and young children at centers in towns like Kingsville, Sinton, Portland, Taft, Odem, Mathis, and Rockport.
records.description_es: Aprendizaje temprano y cuidado infantil gratis para bebés y niños pequeños en centros de pueblos como Kingsville, Sinton, Portland, Taft, Odem, Mathis y Rockport.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children 6 weeks to 5 years old in families under the federal poverty guidelines. Children in foster care, families on TANF, SNAP, or SSI, homeless families, and children with disabilities can qualify regardless of income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños de 6 semanas a 5 años de familias con ingresos por debajo de las guías federales de pobreza. Los niños en cuidado temporal (foster), las familias con TANF, SNAP o SSI, las familias sin hogar y los niños con discapacidad pueden calificar sin importar sus ingresos.
documents_needed: Proof of income (pay stubs, tax forms, or TANF/SNAP documents)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the Apply Now link on the CACOST Head Start page, or call the main office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet con el enlace 'Apply Now' de la página de Head Start de CACOST, o llame a la oficina principal.
records.notes: Head Start income limit is the federal poverty guideline (100% FPL) for regular eligibility.

records.name: CACOST Health Center - Kingsville
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: A community health center offering family, children's, women's, behavioral health, and dental care. It gives income-based discounts to people without insurance.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con atención para la familia, niños, mujeres, salud mental y dental. Da descuentos según sus ingresos a personas sin seguro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Uninsured patients can get lower prices based on income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos. Si no tiene seguro, puede pagar menos según sus ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Call for an appointment or walk in. Same-day appointments are offered.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita o llegue sin cita. Ofrecen citas el mismo día.
records.address: 1311 E. General Cavazos, Ste 303 & Ste C
records.hours: Family: Mon-Fri 8 am-12 pm and 1-5 pm, plus 3rd Saturday 8 am-12 pm; Pediatric: Mon-Fri 8 am-5 pm; Dental: Mon-Fri 8 am-12 pm and 1-5 pm; Behavioral: Mon-Thu 8 am-12 pm and 1-5 pm; Women's: Tuesday 8 am-12 pm and 1-5 pm
records.cost: Sliding scale; accepts Medicaid, CHIP, and most private insurance
records.notes: CACOST also has health centers in Sinton (621 E. Sinton St., 361-364-4486) and Mathis (213 S. Duval St., 361-547-4121) in San Patricio County. Care is given regardless of ability to pay.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Mission Plaza Career Center
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, including resume help, interview practice, career coaching, and training scholarships. It also has services for veterans, youth, people with disabilities, and SNAP job training.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para encontrar trabajo: currículum, práctica para entrevistas, orientación de carrera y becas para capacitación. También tiene servicios para veteranos, jóvenes, personas con discapacidad y capacitación para personas con SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in the 11-county Coastal Bend area. Some training programs have their own rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en los 11 condados del Coastal Bend. Algunos programas de capacitación tienen sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call. You can also register and search jobs at WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de empleo o llame. También puede registrarse y buscar trabajo en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Serves Nueces, San Patricio, Kleberg, Aransas, Kenedy, Bee, Refugio, Live Oak, Brooks, Duval, and Jim Wells counties.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Kingsville Career Center
records.description_en: Local career center offering free job search help, career coaching, and training information.
records.description_es: Centro de empleo local con ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, orientación de carrera e información sobre capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Kleberg County and nearby areas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en el condado de Kleberg y áreas cercanas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center on the Coastal Bend College campus or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en el campus de Coastal Bend College o llame.
records.address: Coastal Bend College Campus, 1814 S. Brahma Blvd.
records.notes: Hours were not listed online; call before visiting. Fax: 888-974-3358.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Sinton Career Center
records.description_en: Local career center offering free job search help, career coaching, and training information.
records.description_es: Centro de empleo local con ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, orientación de carrera e información sobre capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in San Patricio County and nearby areas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en el condado de San Patricio y áreas cercanas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center at Pirate Plaza or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro en Pirate Plaza o llame.
records.notes: Toll-free: (800) 727-4356. Hours were not listed online.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Assistance)
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar el cuidado de sus niños, para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo o estudiar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families with children in the Coastal Bend workforce area. Income and activity rules come from the Texas Workforce Commission.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos con niños en el área de Coastal Bend. Las reglas de ingresos y de actividad vienen de la Comisión de la Fuerza Laboral de Texas (TWC).
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Workforce Commission child care portal (childcare.twc.texas.gov), or call Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet en el portal de cuidado infantil de TWC (childcare.twc.texas.gov), o llame a Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend para recibir ayuda.
records.cost: Subsidy; families may owe a parent share
records.notes: Serves the 11-county Coastal Bend region. There may be a waitlist. More info: workforcesolutionscb.org/child-care/.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent - Victoria Workforce Center
records.description_en: Free job search help, job postings, and training support for people in the Golden Crescent area.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, anuncios de empleo y apoyo para capacitación para personas del área Golden Crescent.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to job seekers in Victoria County and nearby counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para personas que buscan trabajo en el condado de Victoria y condados cercanos.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center, call, or register online at WorkInTexas.com.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro, llame o regístrese en internet en WorkInTexas.com.
records.notes: Board main line: (361) 576-5872. Email gcjobs@gcworkforce.org.

records.name: Child Care Assistance
records.description_en: Helps eligible families pay for child care. The website has enrollment forms and a list of contracted child care providers.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias que califican a pagar el cuidado de sus niños. El sitio web tiene formularios de inscripción y una lista de guarderías que participan.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families in Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Gonzales, Jackson, Lavaca, and Victoria counties, families on or recently off TANF, teen parents in school, and families experiencing homelessness. Parents usually must work or go to school or training at least 25 hours a week (50 hours combined for two parents).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Gonzales, Jackson, Lavaca y Victoria, familias que reciben o dejaron de recibir TANF hace poco, padres adolescentes que estudian y familias sin hogar. Por lo general, los padres deben trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas entre los dos si son dos padres).
records.how_to_apply: Go to the Child Care Assistance page on gcworkforce.org for forms, or call Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la página de Child Care Assistance en gcworkforce.org para ver los formularios, o llame a Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent.
records.cost: Subsidy; families may owe a parent share
records.notes: Families can search for child care at find.childcare.texas.gov. Email: gcjobs@gcworkforce.org.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Aid - Corpus Christi Office
records.description_en: Free legal help with civil problems like evictions, housing, family issues, and public benefits. It has an office downtown and one in the Nueces County Courthouse.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis con problemas civiles como desalojos, vivienda, asuntos de familia y beneficios públicos. Tiene una oficina en el centro y otra en el Palacio de Justicia del condado de Nueces.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who qualify for free legal help. Call the intake line to see if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que califican para ayuda legal gratis. Llame a la línea de admisión para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line on weekdays to apply. Help is available in English and Spanish.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de lunes a viernes para pedir ayuda. Hay ayuda en inglés y en español.
records.hours: Intake phone lines: weekdays 9:00 am-5:00 pm Central
records.notes: Toll-free intake: (833) 329-8752. Courthouse office: Nueces County Courthouse, 901 Leopard St., Room 105. For family law matters, call on Tuesdays and Thursdays only. TRLA serves many counties; call to confirm service for San Patricio or Kleberg.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Aid - Victoria Office
records.description_en: Free legal help with civil problems like evictions, housing, family issues, and public benefits.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal gratis con problemas civiles como desalojos, vivienda, asuntos de familia y beneficios públicos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who qualify for free legal help. Call the intake line to see if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que califican para ayuda legal gratis. Llame a la línea de admisión para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line on weekdays to apply. Help is available in English and Spanish.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión de lunes a viernes para pedir ayuda. Hay ayuda en inglés y en español.
records.hours: Intake phone lines: weekdays 9:00 am-5:00 pm Central
records.notes: Toll-free intake: (833) 329-8752. For family law matters, call on Tuesdays and Thursdays only.

records.name: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.organization: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities (NCMHID)
records.description_en: The public mental health center for Nueces County. It offers crisis help, mental health care for adults and youth, and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental del condado de Nueces. Ofrece ayuda en crisis, atención de salud mental para adultos y jóvenes, y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Nueces County residents who need mental health, crisis, or disability services. Anyone can call the 24-hour crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Nueces y necesitan servicios de salud mental, de crisis o de discapacidad. Cualquier persona puede llamar a la línea de crisis de 24 horas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number for services. In a crisis, call the 24-hour crisis line or 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para pedir servicios. Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas o al 988.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: (888) 767-4493. The old bhcnc.org address now redirects here.

records.name: Gulf Bend Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: The public mental health center for Victoria and nearby counties. It offers mental health care, crisis help, substance use treatment, youth services, veteran services, and help for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.description_es: El centro público de salud mental de Victoria y condados cercanos. Ofrece atención de salud mental, ayuda en crisis, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias, servicios para jóvenes y veteranos, y ayuda para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Victoria, Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio, and Lavaca counties. Anyone can call the 24-hour crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en los condados de Victoria, Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio y Lavaca. Cualquier persona puede llamar a la línea de crisis de 24 horas.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number during business hours. In a crisis, call the 24-hour crisis line or 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal en horario de oficina. Si está en crisis, llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas o al 988.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm (until 7 pm on the first Thursday of the month in Victoria)
records.cost: Fees based on a fee schedule (available in English and Spanish)
records.notes: 24-hour crisis hotline: (877) 723-3422 (877-SAFEGBC). Toll-free: (800) 421-8825. Serves Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio, Lavaca, and Victoria counties; satellite clinics are held on set days in Jackson County, Yoakum, Refugio, and Hallettsville. Walk-in availability was not stated online.

records.name: Public Housing and Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) Programs
records.description_en: Provides lower-cost public housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8) that help pay rent in Corpus Christi.
records.description_es: Ofrece vivienda pública de menor costo y vales de vivienda (Sección 8) que ayudan a pagar la renta en Corpus Christi.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income families who meet federal housing rules. Call or check the website for current waitlist status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos que cumplen las reglas federales de vivienda. Llame o revise el sitio web para saber si la lista de espera está abierta.
documents_needed: Valid email address to register online
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at apply.hacc.org (you need an email address; you can create one for free). If you need help, visit the office on Ayers Street.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet en apply.hacc.org (necesita un correo electrónico; puede crear uno gratis). Si necesita ayuda, vaya a la oficina en Ayers Street.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00 am-6:00 pm; Friday 8:00 am-12:00 pm
records.notes: Waitlist status was not shown on the page; call to check.

records.name: The Salvation Army of the Coastal Bend - Social Services
records.description_en: Offers help with rent and utility bills, emergency shelter programs, disaster relief, and veteran services in Corpus Christi.
records.description_es: Ofrece ayuda con la renta y las cuentas de luz y agua, programas de refugio de emergencia, ayuda en desastres y servicios para veteranos en Corpus Christi.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Corpus Christi area in a crisis. Call to find out what help is open now and who qualifies.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del área de Corpus Christi que están pasando por una crisis. Llame para saber qué ayuda hay ahora y quién califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the social services office on Buford Street.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de servicios sociales en Buford Street.
records.notes: Rent and utility help depends on available funds. Office hours for social services were not listed online; call first. Food help was not confirmed on the page.

records.name: The Salvation Army Victoria - Social Services and Food Assistance
records.description_en: The social services office (Family Aid Center) helps families in need. The Life Enrichment Center offers casework, laundry, showers, and medical clinics.
records.description_es: La oficina de servicios sociales (Family Aid Center) ayuda a familias necesitadas. El Life Enrichment Center ofrece apoyo de un trabajador social, lavandería, duchas y clínicas médicas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Victoria area who need help. Call for details.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del área de Victoria que necesitan ayuda. Llame para más detalles.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the social services office on N. Louis Street.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina de servicios sociales en N. Louis Street.
records.hours: Social services: 9 AM-4 PM; Life Enrichment Center: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM
records.notes: The website does not list the exact kinds of family aid offered (for example food or bill help); call to ask.

records.name: The Salvation Army Victoria - Emergency Shelter for Men
records.description_en: An emergency overnight shelter for men in Victoria.
records.description_es: Un refugio de emergencia para pasar la noche, solo para hombres, en Victoria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adult men who need a place to stay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres adultos que necesitan un lugar donde quedarse.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the shelter during check-in time (4:00-8:00 PM).
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al refugio durante el horario de entrada (de 4:00 a 8:00 pm).
records.notes: Men only.

records.name: Good Samaritan Rescue Mission
records.organization: Good Samaritan Rescue Mission (Good Samaritan Village)
records.description_en: A 24-hour shelter for men and women experiencing homelessness in Corpus Christi. It also has meals, a day labor program, and chaplain services.
records.description_es: Un refugio abierto las 24 horas para hombres y mujeres sin hogar en Corpus Christi. También ofrece comidas, un programa de trabajo por día y apoyo de capellanes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adult men and women who are homeless. You can come in without an ID, and staff will help you get a new one.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hombres y mujeres adultos sin hogar. Puede llegar sin identificación y el personal le ayudará a conseguir una nueva.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the mission at any time, day or night, or call the main line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a la misión a cualquier hora, de día o de noche, o llame a la línea principal.
records.hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
records.notes: Day labor: (361) 883-9493. Food service: (361) 765-0297. The min_age of 18 is based on the page saying it accepts 'adult men and women'.

records.name: Mid-Coast Family Services
records.description_en: Helps survivors of family violence and sexual assault with a crisis center and support services. It also offers housing and rental assistance, youth prevention programs, and family services.
records.description_es: Ayuda a sobrevivientes de violencia familiar y agresión sexual con un centro de crisis y servicios de apoyo. También ofrece ayuda con vivienda y renta, programas de prevención para jóvenes y servicios para familias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in the Victoria area facing family violence, sexual assault, or homelessness. Call the hotline any time.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas del área de Victoria que sufren violencia familiar, agresión sexual o que no tienen hogar. Puede llamar a la línea de ayuda a cualquier hora.
records.how_to_apply: Call the hotline for help right away, or call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda para recibir apoyo de inmediato, o llame a la oficina.
records.notes: Domestic violence and sexual assault hotline: (361) 573-4357 or (800) 870-0368. The website does not list which counties it serves.

records.name: WIC and Public Health Services
records.organization: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.description_en: The city-county health district runs the WIC nutrition program for mothers, babies, and young children. It also has a Robstown satellite clinic and mobile clinics.
records.description_es: El distrito de salud de la ciudad y el condado tiene el programa de nutrición WIC para mamás, bebés y niños pequeños. También tiene una clínica en Robstown y clínicas móviles.
records.eligibility_summary_en: WIC is for pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: WIC es para mujeres embarazadas, que están amamantando o que dieron a luz hace poco, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen las reglas de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the main office on Horne Road. There is also a Robstown satellite clinic and a mobile clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina principal en Horne Road. También hay una clínica en Robstown y una clínica móvil.
records.notes: Email: YourPublicHealth@CorpusChristiTX.gov. The phone and hours are for the main Health District office; WIC-specific clinic phone and hours were not confirmed.

records.name: San Patricio County WIC Program
records.description_en: Provides healthy foods, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding help, including breast pumps, to mothers, babies, and young children. A mobile unit serves people who do not have a ride.
records.description_es: Da alimentos saludables, clases de nutrición y ayuda para amamantar, incluso sacaleches, a mamás, bebés y niños pequeños. Una unidad móvil atiende a quienes no tienen transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children in San Patricio County who meet WIC income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que están amamantando o que dieron a luz hace poco, bebés y niños en el condado de San Patricio que cumplen las reglas de ingresos de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas WIC portal, or call the San Patricio County WIC office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet en el portal de WIC de Texas, o llame a la oficina de WIC del condado de San Patricio.
records.notes: Phone listed is the WIC Director's line. Email: mgarcia@sanpatriciocountytx.gov. Clinic locations are in the county's WIC schedule document or the 'Find a WIC Clinic' tool.

records.name: San Patricio County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: Pays for needed health care for very low-income residents, including doctor visits, shots, hospital care, lab and x-ray, and up to 3 prescriptions a month.
records.description_es: Paga atención médica necesaria para personas con ingresos muy bajos, como visitas al doctor, vacunas, hospital, laboratorio, rayos X y hasta 3 recetas al mes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For San Patricio County residents with household income at or below 21% of the federal poverty level and resources under $2,000.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de San Patricio con ingresos de hasta 21% del nivel federal de pobreza y bienes de menos de $2,000.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the office for a screening. If you qualify, you will get an application. Outreach is also held in Mathis, Ingleside, and Aransas Pass.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o visite la oficina para una evaluación. Si califica, le darán una solicitud. También hay visitas en Mathis, Ingleside y Aransas Pass.
records.notes: Outreach: Mathis 1st Tuesday at 600 N Frio; Ingleside 1st Thursday at 2681 San Angelo; Aransas Pass 2nd Thursday at 1212 W Wheeler (all 9-11:30 am). A printable application is on the county website. The resource limit and covered services come from the original research and were not re-confirmed on this page.

records.name: Kleberg County Indigent Health Care and Welfare Services
records.description_en: The county office for indigent health care and welfare help for low-income Kleberg County residents.
records.description_es: La oficina del condado de Kleberg para atención médica de personas de bajos recursos y otra ayuda social.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Kleberg County residents. Call to learn the current rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que viven en el condado de Kleberg. Llame para saber las reglas actuales.
records.how_to_apply: Call the indigent health care line or the welfare line, or visit the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de atención médica o a la línea de ayuda social, o visite la oficina.
records.notes: Indigent line: (361) 595-8569. Welfare line: (361) 595-8555. The page also lists the Kleberg County Courthouse, 700 E Kleberg Ave. It does not say what kinds of welfare help are offered, or office hours.

records.name: Nueces Aid Healthcare Access
records.description_en: Helps low-income Nueces County residents get affordable health care.
records.description_es: Ayuda a personas de bajos ingresos del condado de Nueces a recibir atención médica a bajo costo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income and needy residents of Nueces County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos y necesitadas que viven en el condado de Nueces.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online on the Hospital District website, or apply in person at an enrollment site such as 600 Elizabeth St. in Corpus Christi.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en internet en el sitio web del Distrito Hospitalario, o en persona en un lugar de inscripción como 600 Elizabeth St. en Corpus Christi.
records.notes: Other enrollment sites: Dr. Hector P. Garcia Memorial Family Health Center, 2606 Hospital Blvd. (361) 902-4855; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Robstown, 1038 Texas Yes Blvd. (361) 861-9005; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Westside, 4617 Greenwood Rd. (361) 814-8448. Admin office: 555 N. Carancahua St., (361) 808-3300. Income limits were not on the page.

records.name: Victoria Transit (Fixed Route and Para Transit)
records.description_en: Public bus service in Victoria, plus Para Transit door-to-door rides for seniors and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: Autobús público en Victoria, más el servicio Para Transit que lleva de puerta a puerta a personas mayores y personas con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Fixed-route buses are open to everyone. Para Transit is for seniors and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los autobuses de ruta fija son para todos. Para Transit es para personas mayores y personas con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Call GCRPC for routes, fares, and to ask about Para Transit rides.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a GCRPC para preguntar por rutas, precios y viajes de Para Transit.
records.notes: Phone is GCRPC's main line; a Victoria Transit-specific number, hours, and fares were not shown. GCRPC announced new Victoria Transit fixed-route service. Email: contact@gcrpc.org.
